entries.summary: New files: `common/src/ads/agentic-ad-lab-bench.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-declared-installs.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-skill-checks.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-skill.ts` (+3 more).

ai.title: Add sponsored skill format, declared installs, and ad lab bench
ai.summary: The sponsored ads subsystem gains a skill format and a declared install gate: `sponsored-declared-installs.ts` lets a run install only the exact packages its skill declares, executing them with `--ignore-scripts` and `--save-exact` to skip lifecycle hooks. The CLI's `sponsored-run.ts` now resolves declared packages from the procedure hash and replaces the blanket install refusal with this check, while `sponsored-step-driver.ts` adds a harness-driven step loop that validates agent work against deterministic checks. The Agentic Ads Lab gains `agentic-ad-lab-bench.ts` with a pinned `LAB_BENCH` of 25 repositories and a `compareLabBatches` gate that blocks regression on any single repository, alongside raising `LAB_BATCH_MAX_REPOSITORIES` to 30 in `agentic-ad-lab-batch.ts`.
ai.evidence: The diff introduces `sponsored-declared-installs.ts` and `sponsored-skill.ts` in `common/src/ads/`, adds `agentic-ad-lab-bench.ts` with `LAB_BENCH`, and modifies `cli/src/utils/sponsored-run.ts` to use `evaluateSponsoredInstallCommand` for package installation checks.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the runtime consumer that calls `driveSponsoredSkillSteps` in a live sponsored session.

changes.what: Adds `sponsored-declared-installs.ts` to gate package installs to a skill's declared list with canonical `--ignore-scripts` commands.
Introduces `sponsored-skill.ts` defining the skill data format, parsing, validation, and hash-locking for advertiser procedures.
Adds `sponsored-step-driver.ts` and `sponsored-skill-checks.ts` to run a deterministic step loop that evaluates checks and prompts the agent to fix failures.
Updates `sponsored-run.ts` and `sponsored-agent.ts` to resolve declared packages from the procedure hash and replace the blanket install refusal with the new gate.
Adds `agentic-ad-lab-bench.ts` with a pinned `LAB_BENCH` of repositories and `compareLabBatches`, and raises `LAB_BATCH_MAX_REPOSITORIES` to 30 in `agentic-ad-lab-batch.ts`.

eli5.text: The automated system that runs paid tasks on a user's computer now allows the installation of specific software tools, but only when the task's written instructions explicitly list them by name and exact version. This narrow permission replaces the previous blanket ban on adding new tools, ensuring that hidden setup scripts never run and that the user's review of the changes remains complete. The internal testing suite also grew from ten to thirty sample projects, so the system can now check its work against a wider range of common software setups before a task is released to the public.
